defect: Coin theft through request-supplied identity: POST /api/economic/marketplace/buy debited whatever account body.odId named (worked exploit of record: a fresh account 'bought' in a victim's name, victim 88 -> 83 CC). Same class on artistry purchases/listings (+ /api/creative-commerce alias), rights transfers, billing keys, frontier routes.
found_by: Redesign audit (step 1) + live repro on a dev server during the build (commit 847cf80a8).
walk_evidence: No ticket in the walk-1 corpus (probe: market x identity/theft/odId/buyerId = 0).

check.name: Actor-spoof probe
check.sketch: As t2, submit t1's id in every actor-shaped field (odId, buyerId, ownerId, fromUserId, userId, hostId) on each write route the lens exposes; verdict requires 403/refusal AND t1's balance and objects byte-unchanged. Extends the foreign-row probe from reads to writes.

defect: The shipped guard's own bypass: actor-identity rules were case-sensitive regexes anchored with $ against req.path, while Express 5.3 routes case-insensitively and ignores trailing slashes — POST /api/Economic/marketplace/buy or a trailing slash reached the handler with the guard passed.
found_by: Desk review of PR #2396 (Zuko 2, read-only), reproduced against express@5.3.0.
walk_evidence: No ticket; the defect postdates walk 1 (it lives in the fix), recorded here because the catching check belongs to the same probe family.

check.name: Actor-spoof route-variant leg
check.sketch: The ACTOR-SPOOF probe repeats each spoofed write against case-variants and trailing-slash variants of the route; any variant that lands the write fails the lens.

defect: Missed theft route: POST /api/lens-culture/purchase debited body.userId's ledger balance via purchaseArtifact and was not in the guard's ACTOR_RULES at all.
found_by: Desk review of PR #2396 (route-by-route census of 183 write routes).

check.name: Actor-field census
check.sketch: Static census over server routes: every write handler reading an actor-shaped field from body/query/params must either take the actor from the session or appear in the guard's rule set; an unlisted reader files. Runs over git show at the walk build.

defect: Path-param actors uncovered: /api/world/sim/progression/:userId/*, federation /users/:userId/location|preferences act on the named user without a self check; billing GET /keys/:userId and /usage/:userId let anyone read another user's data (the guard covers writes only).
found_by: Desk review of PR #2396.

check.name: Path-param actor probe
check.sketch: For every route carrying a :userId-shaped param, t2 reads and writes t1's param value; any 2xx with t1's data or a landed write fails. Read routes included, not only writes.

defect: /api/artistry/collab/share: the guard stops a spoofed ownerId, but the handler never checks the caller owns the project — anyone could add collaborators to any project by simply omitting ownerId. Identity-correct, ownership-absent.
found_by: Desk review of PR #2396.

check.name: Cross-account object-mutation probe
check.sketch: t2 attempts create/update/delete/share on t1's objects by id, sending t2's OWN identity correctly everywhere; any landed mutation fails. This is the general form of the podcast/graph/film ownership finds — run it on every lens's object verbs, not only where a ticket points.

defect: False 403 introduced by the fix: FeedTimelinePanel sent { userId: 'current-user' } to the collab join, which the new guard correctly refused — honest users would have hit a wall the redesign shipped.
found_by: Desk review of PR #2396 (predicted, in writing, that 'the walker will log this as a regression on the Feed lens').

check.name: Placeholder-identity scan + legitimate-action leg
check.sketch: Code-scan: client code must never send literal identity placeholders ('current-user', 'me', 'self') in actor fields. Walker leg: every legitimate write a lens offers must complete for its owner — a 403 on an owner's own action files as a finding, not a pass.

defect: Commission escrow over-release: holdEscrow held agreed_price minus the 1.46% TRANSFER fee in __ESCROW__, but release/refund paid the full agreed_price — every approved commission drew the difference from other users' escrowed coin. Latent (no HTTP route called holdEscrow) and incomplete (the hold escrowed the caller-supplied amount, not agreed_price).
found_by: Redesign audit of the Market backend (commit a59109f4b) + desk review (latent/incomplete halves).
walk_evidence: No ticket (probe: market x escrow = 0). No UI or network signal existed pre-fix — the catching leg is the code-scan form.

check.name: Escrow conservation check
check.sketch: Code-scan over money services: hold and release/refund amounts must derive from ONE stored figure on the row (escrow_held), never recomputed from price or taken from the caller; where a hold route exists, the network form runs hold -> release and hold -> refund and asserts the shared account's balance returns exactly.

defect: Orphaned-action census: 25 lens actions lost their only frontend caller in PR #2396 by the desk review's count; B3's domain-qualified census at the freeze merge found 52 caller-less actions in the merged tree (studio x24, music x18, code x5, github x3, dtu.listByKind) — every backend macro verified still present. The Studio/Music parity question rides as an open founder call in issues #2393/#2394.
found_by: Desk review census + B3's merge-time census (GB-1565).
walk_evidence: No ticket; walk 1's wiring capture holds the raw material (controls exercised) but no census inverted it against the domain registry.

check.name: Macro-reachability census
check.sketch: Invert the wiring capture: domain macros (server/domains registry at the walk build) minus macros exercised by any control in the walk minus macros with a non-UI caller of record (agent/MCP) = the orphan list, filed per lens per walk. A macro that loses its last UI caller between walks files automatically.

defect: Duplicate primary surface: a second register (RetailWorkbench) lived in a drawer beside LivePosTerminal and CommerceSuite, under two stacked tab strips and shared chrome panels (NorthStarFrame, ShellPreview, RealtimeDataPanel).
found_by: Redesign audit step 1 (surface inventory) — the playbook's stacking census.

check.name: Duplicate-surface census
check.sketch: From the walk's DOM/control inventory: two distinct mounts offering the same primary verb on the same domain objects (two registers, two players, two tab systems for one lens) files as a stacking finding with both mounts named.

defect: Double-cart race: two fast taps on an empty register opened two carts.
found_by: Playbook step 6 — the full-day browser drive against a real backend.

check.name: Rapid-repeat action probe
check.sketch: Fire the lens's primary create action twice in immediate succession (double-click timing); exactly one object may exist afterwards, verified by API read-back.

defect: Till-close ledger refused as duplicate_blocked whenever a previous close shared shop/date/figures — the DTU gate refuses exact-title repeats store-wide, so a legitimate repeated close could never mint.
found_by: Playbook step 6 — browser drive (close twice with identical figures).

check.name: Repeat-identical action leg
check.sketch: Perform the same legitimate action twice with byte-identical payloads (close, publish, submit); the second must succeed or refuse with a reason the user can act on — a duplicate-content refusal on a distinct real event fails.

defect: A section page wrapper defined as a component inside render remounted every panel on any parent re-render, dropping panel state.
found_by: Redesign build (wiring the section views), playbook step 5's 'never define components inside render' rule.

check.name: Component-in-render scan
check.sketch: Static pattern over lens components: a component declared inside another component's render body files, with the state-drop consequence named.

defect: Discount desync on line edit: editing a cart line did not re-sync the applied discount (fixed-amount codes kept their value as the subtotal moved; a code whose minimum stopped being met had to be dropped and reported — neither happened).
found_by: Redesign backend build (register primitives, commit f2b756286) with adversarial tests.

check.name: Invariant read-back probe
check.sketch: After any mutation sequence the walk performs (apply code -> edit line -> change qty), read the object back through the API and assert the domain invariants (totals = sum of lines - discount; code state consistent with its minimum) rather than trusting the UI's displayed figures.

defect: One product fragmented across four pages (lens, demo, designs, workbench), each mounting its own shell of the same app.
found_by: Redesign audit step 1.

check.name: Route-family fragmentation census
check.sketch: Census: routes serving one domain that mount disjoint shells with duplicated navigation file as a fragmentation observation for the dossier (W2), ranked by duplicated control count.

defect: React 'synchronously unmount a root while rendering' error on every load: drei <Html> created one React root per beam label.
found_by: Redesign build + browser verification (console read).
walk_evidence: No ticket — the walk captures console output, but no zero-console-error gate turned it into a finding here.

check.name: Zero-console-error load gate
check.sketch: A lens load + primary-flow drive with any console error (framework errors named separately from network 4xx) files; the walk already captures the signal — the check is the gate that prices it.

defect: A newly designed object did not update the URL — reloading lost it.
found_by: Redesign browser verification.

check.name: Reload-persistence leg
check.sketch: After creating/opening an object, reload the page: the object must still be addressable and open (URL or restored state); losing it files.

defect: The overlay backdrop was a clickable div — pointer-only, no keyboard path (Escape now the keyboard route).
found_by: Redesign build (a11y pass).

check.name: Interactive-semantics scan
check.sketch: Clickable elements that are not buttons/links and carry no role/tabindex file per lens; the keyboard leg then drives the same overlays by keyboard alone.

defect: The Parity workbench edited a second copy of the song (project.tracks/clips/midiNotes) that the audio engine never plays (it plays project.daw) — a whole surface of edits that silently did nothing audible. ~24 parity-store macros now have no Studio UI (issue #2393, founder call pending).
found_by: Redesign audit (tracing which store the engine reads).
walk_evidence: FIX-011 caught the symptom ('Demo vs Parity workbench track count mismatch') — the divergence was seen; the root cause (two stores, one never played) was the audit's find.

check.name: Dual-store divergence probe
check.sketch: Where two surfaces present the same object, edit through one and read through the other AND through the engine's own read path; any divergence files with both stores named. Census form: two writable stores for one domain object file on sight.

defect: 48 dead or duplicate files removed, including ~18 pre-rebuild components sitting behind an unused barrel export — importable, plausible, and mounted nowhere.
found_by: Redesign audit (import-graph census).

check.name: Orphan-component census
check.sketch: Components under components/<lens>/ with no import path from the lens's mounted tree file per walk (the dossier's mounted-vs-orphaned inventory, W2 section 1, run as a check).

defect: Input-validation gaps across markers/midi/fx-rack macros: NaN beat positions, unbounded section/map/chain counts, unvalidated colour strings, non-finite params — all accepted and stored.
found_by: Redesign hardening build (commit 6606ffa57) under playbook step 3's validate-hard rule.
walk_evidence: No ticket — formfuzz works the UI's forms; these are macro-level inputs behind them.

check.name: Macro-level adversarial fuzz
check.sketch: Extend formfuzz below the form: for each create/update macro the lens exposes, submit the adversarial value set (NaN, Infinity, '1e999', negatives, booleans, oversized counts, injection-shaped text) directly; acceptance of a value the domain cannot mean files, and refused calls must write nothing (read-back).

defect: Solo collab-edit with no session open returned { ok:false, 'no active session' } — every solo publish logged a 400, training users to ignore real errors.
found_by: Redesign build (console read during the drive).

check.name: Happy-path cleanliness leg
check.sketch: The lens's canonical happy path (create -> edit -> publish solo) must produce zero 4xx/5xx in the netledger; error noise on legitimate paths files.

defect: The upload path stamped fabricated metadata on every track: BPM 128, key Am, -14 LUFS, artist 'You' — invented analysis presented as measured fact.
found_by: Redesign audit (comparing stored metadata against a known file).

check.name: Media ground-truth probe
check.sketch: Upload a file whose true properties are measured independently first (duration, tempo, dimensions); every figure the lens stores or displays must equal the measurement or be honestly blank — a constant value across two different files files on sight.

defect: Two balances that never synced: economy_ledger (what the wallet shows; purchases land there) vs an in-memory wallet map that purchaseWithRoyalties checked — a fan holding 98.54 CC was refused every purchase with insufficient_balance, balance 0. The balance endpoint also read the raw map and showed 0.
found_by: Playbook step 6 — driving the lens in a real browser with a funded account (commit f9bc69c61, owner-approved fix).
walk_evidence: No ticket. Money routes are deny-listed out of the walker's two-account probes by design — the gap is a sanctioned money-probe lane, named in the study.

check.name: Balance-coherence probe
check.sketch: In the test-account lane (C24 ruling: test accounts only, money OFF in prod): fund through the real coin-purchase path, then read the balance at every surface (wallet, balance endpoint, purchase check) and spend; all readings must agree at every step.

defect: dtu.create returns a presentation copy over HTTP (_presentDtuPublic); licensing that copy never reached the stored DTU, so marketplace.list refused with license_scope_denied — publishing over HTTP was broken while internal callers worked. Issue #2394 flags the same latent bug in engineering.mint-and-list / asset-marketplace (ruled: fix after walk 2).
found_by: Redesign build (publishing a release end to end over HTTP), pinned with an HTTP-shaped (non-internal) context.

check.name: HTTP-shape round-trip leg
check.sketch: Flows must be exercised over HTTP exactly as a client does them (create -> mutate -> list/read), never via internal calls; a step that only works internally files. The presentation-copy mutation pattern is the named genus: mutating a returned object must persist, or the API must refuse honestly.

defect: Publish state kept in memory only: a cover's public flip and a release DTU's scope/licence/listing evaporated on backend restart — fans got 404 no_artifact for covers of published releases.
found_by: Redesign verification (restart the backend, re-read as a new fan).

check.name: Restart-persistence leg
check.sketch: Against a staging backend: publish through the lens, restart the backend, re-read every public surface as a second account; anything that 404s or reverts files. (Runs in the CI/staging lane, not against prod.)

defect: Macro families with no Liner Notes surface (issue #2394): jam-*, dj-session, ai-playlist, device-*, download-*, share-card, concert-listings, friend-activity, scheduled-playlist-*, playlist-collab-edit, track-lyrics-*/lyrics-autofetch, stream-analytics, publish-as-stem, mb-* — all registered and agent-callable, none reachable by a person.
found_by: Redesign audit (macro census vs the new surface).

check.name: Macro-reachability census
check.sketch: As X-08: the per-lens orphan list, with the agent/MCP-only set named separately so a deliberate agent-only macro is a decision, not a discovery.

defect: Every in-browser run hung: the PWA service worker answered web-worker scripts cache-first and the worker never started. Compounded in the runner: module workers could not load Turbopack's importScripts bootstrap, load time was counted as run time, files with export failed 'exports is not defined', and a silent runner was never replaced.
found_by: Redesign build (running real code in the browser runner).

check.name: Runner-truth probe
check.sketch: In any lens offering run/execute: run a trivial program with known output and a deliberate error; the run must return the true output/error within a time budget, and reported run time must exclude load time. A hang files as a dead surface, not a slow one.

defect: The TypeScript language service resolved no relative imports between project files — multi-file projects typechecked against a phantom.
found_by: Redesign build.

check.name: Multi-file fixture probe
check.sketch: Seed a two-file project with a relative import (one correct, one deliberately broken); the lens's type check must pass the first and flag the second at the right file/line.

defect: Diff arithmetic: an empty base counted as one removed line, so a file added to an empty project showed a phantom removal.
found_by: Redesign build (proof-diff), pinned by a behaviour test.

check.name: Diff-arithmetic probe
check.sketch: Add a file of N lines to an empty project: the diff must read +N / -0. Edit one line: +1 / -1. Counts are read from the UI and the API and must agree.

defect: The workbench collapsed to its 420px floor whenever a full-screen overlay sat at the bottom edge.
found_by: Redesign build + browser drive.

check.name: Overlay-geometry leg
check.sketch: Open each full-screen overlay the lens has; the underlying workbench's geometry must survive (height within tolerance of the no-overlay reading) — extends the overflow/offscreen family from horizontal to overlay states.

defect: A blank rename in the file pane vanished silently — the user could not tell the rename was cancelled (the code-003 regression genus).
found_by: Post-redesign fix pass on the #2398 branch; the genus test guarded it, the new UI had reintroduced it.

check.name: Cancelled-edit acknowledgement leg
check.sketch: Blank or escape out of every inline edit (rename, title, name); the surface must show the cancellation (or keep the editor open) — a silent no-op files.

defect: Five news tests failed wherever DNS was unavailable and tested nothing where it was: the fetch stubs were bypassed by the SSRF-guarded fetch, so the suites exercised the live network or nothing.
found_by: Redesign build (running the domain suite in a no-DNS environment).
walk_evidence: No ticket — a test-integrity defect, invisible to a UI walk by construction; the catcher is a CI-lane check.

check.name: Stub-transport audit
check.sketch: Domain suites must route fetches through the test transport: run the suite with egress disabled — it must stay green; a suite that only passes with live network, or whose stubs the SSRF chokepoint bypasses, files.

defect: Proof called lensRun('code', ...) through a non-literal domain expression, so the wiring verifier could not see the Code lens at all — a lens invisible to the platform's own reachability tooling.
found_by: Redesign build (the wiring verifier's blind spot, found from the verifier's side).

check.name: Wiring-literal scan
check.sketch: lensRun/macro invocations must name their domain as a string literal; a computed domain files, and any domain the verifier cannot see files as unreachable-by-tooling.

defect: The pieces drawer crashed on art-dashboard's promptOfTheDay shape — the macro returns {category, text}, the drawer read it as a string.
found_by: Redesign browser drive.

check.name: Seeded panel sweep
check.sketch: On a seeded account holding real data in the lens's own shapes, open every panel, drawer and tab; any error boundary or crash files with the panel named. (Walk 1 opened panels on largely empty accounts, where shape bugs hide.)

defect: SSRF: rss-refresh fetched any user-supplied URL with plain fetch — an open server-side request forgery on a creator surface.
found_by: Redesign audit (code read of the refresh path), fixed to the SSRF-guarded fetchPublicUrl.
walk_evidence: No ticket (probe: podcast x ssrf/fetch = 0). formfuzz submits bad input to forms; it does not aim URL-ingesting fields at internal targets.

check.name: SSRF probe + raw-fetch scan
check.sketch: Network form: submit loopback/link-local/internal URLs to every URL-ingesting field; any fetched response files. Scan form: server code fetching a user-supplied URL outside fetchPublicUrl files on sight (W2 dossier flag).

defect: Missing ownership checks across the creator surface: anyone could repoint any show's feed URL, add episodes to any show, overwrite any transcript, and edit/delete RSS-imported episodes.
found_by: Redesign audit (handler-by-handler ownership read).
walk_evidence: The walk-1-era Product pass noted the unowned-show episode form as an untested §8 observation — seen, never exercised. No ULW ticket.

check.name: Cross-account object-mutation probe
check.sketch: As X-05, aimed at creator surfaces: t2 attempts feed repoint, episode add, transcript overwrite, edit and delete on t1's show; every one must refuse and write nothing.

defect: Fabricated transcript timings: plain-text transcripts were given invented proportional timestamps, presented as real timings a read-along could follow.
found_by: Redesign audit (comparing displayed timings against the source transcript).

check.name: Fabrication probe
check.sketch: Supply input with NO timing/metadata (plain-text transcript, silent file, unmeasured track); any precise-looking derived figure the surface presents as fact (timestamps, BPM, durations) files — honest 'untimed/estimated' labelling passes.

defect: A 'Listen 5m' button added five minutes of listening progress without any audio playing — progress as a button press, not a fact.
found_by: Redesign audit.
walk_evidence: No ticket. (The Product pass filed the playback-ledger family — plays unrecorded, positions unsaved — the opposite failure of the same ledger.)

check.name: Progress-truth probe
check.sketch: With media paused/never started, click every progress-shaped control; listening progress, play counts and positions must not move. Then play for a measured interval: progress must move by that interval, read back through the API.

defect: Uploads silently truncated at ~7.5 KB: the JSON /api/media/upload base64 field is cut by the request sanitizer (upload_truncated), so no real episode ever uploaded through it.
found_by: Redesign audit (uploading a real file and comparing bytes).
walk_evidence: FIX-podcast-006 caught the surface ('Episode audio upload unusable — click-to-browse and drag-drop never attach a file'); the truncation mechanism and the endpoint rule are the audit's find.

check.name: Upload-truth probe
check.sketch: Upload files of ladder sizes (7 KB, 100 KB, 10 MB, 100 MB where the lens claims them) through the lens's own path; stored byte count and hash must equal the sent file at every rung, and the endpoint used must be the raw endpoint, never the JSON base64 one.

defect: Three separate players and two stacked tab systems in one lens; eleven panels removed in the redesign including an orphaned ItunesPodcastPanel.
found_by: Redesign audit step 1 (surface inventory).

check.name: Duplicate-surface census
check.sketch: As RT-01: duplicate players are the named genus — two live media players for one catalogue file in the census.

defect: Publishing ran no verification check at all: knowledge DTUs could be published (and listed on the marketplace) with no current, non-refuted receipt from the verification gate, and empirical claims needed no declared source — on every publish path (publishDTU and marketplace.list).
found_by: Redesign audit (reading the publish paths end to end).

check.name: Publish-gate probe
check.sketch: On test accounts: publish a knowledge DTU with no receipt, with a refuted receipt, and an empirical claim with no source, through EVERY publish path the platform exposes; each must refuse. Then publish a properly receipted DTU: it must succeed (the gate is a gate, not a wall).

defect: The old browse mixed machine rows into the public catalogue: error reports, chat memory, notes and till records sat beside works and knowledge, unlabelled.
found_by: Redesign audit (catalogue census by DTU class).
walk_evidence: No ticket for dtus (the class itself is of record from Timeline/Podcast instances).

check.name: Catalogue-purity probe
check.sketch: Public browse surfaces are censused by row class: personal-context and system rows (error reports, chat memory, internal consolidations) must never appear; hidden classes must be counted and labelled where a filter reveals them.

defect: Published cards never reached the library while the DTU sat on the 'local' federation tier — published, and invisible where readers look.
found_by: Redesign build (publish -> library round trip).

check.name: Publish-visibility round trip
check.sketch: Publish as t1, then find the item in the public library/browse as t2 and signed out; a published item unreachable in the public surface files.

defect: Uploads over 10 MB were cut by the Next proxy (its body limit) while the backend's raw cap is 200 MB — real footage could never arrive, with the failure surfacing far from its cause.
found_by: Redesign build (uploading real footage).

check.name: Upload-truth probe
check.sketch: As PC-05, with the size ladder run to the lens's claimed maximum and each rung's failure attributed to its layer (proxy vs backend vs sanitizer) in the finding.

defect: The stream access rule did not honour licences: buyers lost access to a film after the maker withdrew it — a purchase that evaporates on the seller's later action.
found_by: Redesign backend build (release/shop work).

check.name: Licence-persistence probe
check.sketch: t2 buys t1's priced release (test lane); t1 withdraws it; t2's access must stand, and a non-buyer's must not open. Withdrawal semantics are read from the served build, not assumed.

defect: Two never-mounted components shipped in the lens (removed in the redesign); the review and watch-party panels were replaced wholesale by the screening room.
found_by: Redesign audit (import-graph census).

check.name: Orphan-component census
check.sketch: As ST-02.

defect: Export was partly fake: GIF and PNG 'exports' downloaded a JSON file, and MP4 fell back to the same JSON — the download succeeded, the artifact was a lie about its format.
found_by: The walk itself: FIX-animation-001 ('GIF export downloads a .json file, not a GIF'). The redesign fixed the whole family (real WebCodecs/GIF/PNG-ZIP encoders).
walk_evidence: FIX-animation-001 (walk-1 ticket corpus). The one clean catch in this study — and it came from reading downloaded bytes, the media_probes discipline.

check.name: Export-truth probe
check.sketch: Every export/download a lens offers: the delivered bytes' magic numbers and container must match the claimed format (GIF89a, PNG, MP4 ftyp, WebM), and a media export must decode to the real content. Formalizes the FIX-animation-001 catch into a standing probe for every lens with an export.

defect: The soundtrack was never uploaded at all — a headline feature silently absent end to end (no upload, no playback, no export mix).
found_by: Redesign audit (tracing the soundtrack feature's data path to its missing first step).

check.name: Attachment round-trip probe
check.sketch: For every attach/upload affordance: upload a real file, reload, and consume it at every surface that claims it (player, share page, export); absence at any surface files with the surface named.

defect: Share pages could not play: a shared animation opened but its media would not stream (and share tokens were weak — now 128-bit random).
found_by: Redesign backend build (share-grant rework).

check.name: Signed-out share probe
check.sketch: Open every share link signed out: the shared media must play/stream; revoke the link: it must stop. Token form: share tokens are censused for entropy (>=128-bit random) in the code-scan leg (TOKEN-ENTROPY).

defect: Uploaded durations were rounded to whole seconds — short renders lost their length everywhere duration is shown or enforced.
found_by: Redesign build.

check.name: Duration-fidelity probe
check.sketch: Upload media of 1.4 s and 2.6 s true duration; stored/displayed durations must hold sub-second truth (within a frame), never whole-second rounding.

defect: setMediaSaleTerms stretched every preview to 15 s regardless of the caller's floor — a priced animation could not have the shorter (or no) preview its maker set.
found_by: Redesign build (media-sale terms path).

check.name: Preview-terms probe
check.sketch: Set preview terms (30 s, 5 s, none) on priced media in the test lane; stream enforcement as a non-buyer must match the set terms exactly, per the platform's 30 s signed-out rule where it applies.

defect: The lens was badged 'Simulated' although it is the animator's own real work (now REAL_WORKSPACE) — a declaration lying about the surface's nature.
found_by: Redesign audit (registry vs reality).

check.name: Badge-truth scan
check.sketch: A lens whose macros write real user data must not carry a Simulated badge, and a Simulated surface must not write; registry declarations are diffed against the domain's actual write set per walk.

defect: ~55 macros exposed by the animation domain were mounted nowhere in the lens (GB-1575's figure from the redesign audit).
found_by: Redesign audit (macro census).

defect: A graph map could rewrite anyone's DTU: link-node-dtu took any existing id, and node-update / sync-to-dtu then wrote the map node's label and notes into that DTU's title and content — someone else's published work, seed knowledge, anything.
found_by: Redesign backend audit (security read of the map write path), commit 68d59d289.
walk_evidence: No ticket (probe: graph x authorization/rewrite = 0). The walk's graph findings were load failures (FIX-graph-006) — the surface broke before its write path could be exercised.

check.name: Cross-account object-mutation probe
check.sketch: As X-05 — graph is the canonical instance: link t1's DTU into t2's map, edit the node, sync; t1's DTU must be byte-unchanged.

defect: Lineage shape bug: dtu.create stores lineage as a bare array when given lineage: [], but the graph index only read lineage.parents — those children had no edges in any graph view. Lineage existed; the graph silently showed none.
found_by: Redesign backend build (index read against the create shape).

check.name: Lineage round-trip probe
check.sketch: Create a child DTU declaring lineage in each shape the API accepts; the edge must appear in graph reads (and the parent's 'built on by') for every accepted shape.

defect: The Genome view was always empty — a live-looking surface rendering nothing for every user (folded into the catalogue card's lineage in the redesign).
found_by: Redesign audit.
walk_evidence: No ticket naming the Genome view (FIX-graph-006 covers Maps/Mind map load failures, a different surface).

check.name: Panel-population probe
